Hi Alyssa / Paul,

Sorry we missed you on today's slot — I saw the calendar change and hope it wasn't a travel nightmare. No worries at all. I wanted to share three compact ways to get the demo back in your hands without blocking a large window: 

1) 20-minute focused run-through (live) — I demo the core flows you care about and send a short recording.
   • Proposed windows: Tue 3/18 10:00–10:20 PT, Wed 3/19 11:15–11:35 PT, Fri 3/21 08:45–09:05 PT
2) Drop-in office hours — 30-minute open slot where multiple teams can pop in for quick Q&A. Next one: Wed 3/19 11:00–12:00 PT.
3) Pre-recorded short walkthrough + 15-min live Q&A — I’ll send the recording first, then we pick one 15-min slot to answer questions.

If any of the three options works, reply with the preferred window and I’ll send a calendar invite and a recording stub after the session. You can also grab a time directly: https://calendly.com/soojin/redwood-20m (I've attached an .ics with the three proposed mini-slots for convenience).

If travel is the cause, option #3 is usually easiest — I’ll send the recording and we can do Q&A when you’re back.

Attachments (stubs): redwood-compact-demo-recording.mp4 (will send after live demo), soojin-offer-3x-times.ics

Thanks — happy to be flexible. 

— Soojin
